decision.reason: The only evidence, [ev-16a2231637ae], is a one-line release-notes title that points to PR #6662. It doesn't say what render did before or after the change, which users of `crossplane render` are affected, or what the effect on the output is. The title is also ambiguous: it could mean the fix makes render ignore the XR Ready state, or that render previously ignored it. Both proposals assumed the second reading. To decide the change direction, applicability and consequence, we need the PR description or a fuller release note.
